summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the rich repository. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]. rich/control.py adds the format entry for the title sequence (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and the Control.title classmethod. rich/console.py adds set_window_title, which gates only on is_terminal and returns a bool. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch that calls term.set_title with the title text. CHANGELOG.md gains an Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests were added to tests/test_control.py, tests/test_console.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was run, committed, or installed, per instructions. Verification is by reading only; mypy and black were not run. Known caveat: on TERM=dumb, set_window_title returns True but Console.control drops the segment, which follows the spec's terminal-only gate.
